name: libera-donations
reviewNote: Small TS/ESM app, clean control case (already uses new Stripe; Stripe.errors.* only in instanceof value position). Pure tsc typecheck. Tests use node:test; src/services/stripe.test.ts only tests integeriseAmount, but importing stripe.js pulls config.ts (zod-validated env, STRIPE_SECRET_KEY required) so dummy env vars may be needed. No lifecycle scripts.

name: seventy-api
reviewNote: No pure typecheck script: build is 'tsc && tsc-alias --resolve-full-paths' (emits); use 'npx tsc --noEmit' manually, but Prisma client must be generated first ('prisma generate', downloads engines). Specs use fake keys and casted Stripe objects (stripe.gateway.spec.ts), no network seen; other specs (cron, webhooks, membership.service) not fully inspected. No root manifest; no lifecycle scripts.

name: 1940s-nyc-backend
invalidReason: Baseline npm installation fails at this pinned commit: eslint-config-jboolean@2.0.0 requires eslint 9.x, while the project resolves eslint 8.57.1. No Stripe migration was run.
reviewNote: 'types' script is plain 'tsc' but tsconfig has outDir .build and no noEmit, so it emits; use 'npx tsc --noEmit' instead. Typecheck may need generated code (tsoa routes, printful openapi-ts client) - risk. postinstall patch-package is local only; avoid root install (prepare runs submodule script). Jest suite contents not inspected - treat test as unverified. Serverless/AWS deploy scripts must not be run.

name: aikinote-backend
reviewNote: 'build' is 'tsc' with outDir dist (emits), no noEmit script; run 'pnpm exec tsc --noEmit' manually. Use test:ci, not 'test' (plain vitest = watch mode). vitest config sets fake SUPABASE_URL=https://localhost:3000 and happy-dom; no external network seen, but individual tests not inspected. backend has its own pnpm-lock.yaml (root is a pnpm workspace); install inside backend only.

name: humanlogs
reviewNote: Pure tsc typecheck, but Prisma client types must be generated (npx prisma generate; downloads engines; 'migrate' script also runs db push - never run it). vitest runs tests/unit (pure) and tests/integration which binds a real Socket.io server on an ephemeral localhost port - local only, no external network. Stripe usage is via a Proxy wrapper around new Stripe.

name: flashcards-backend
reviewNote: Tiny plain-JS CJS backend: no typecheck (JS, no tsconfig), test script is the npm placeholder that exits 1, so null. Only 'start: node server.js'. Useful as a minimal call-without-new constructor case; validate by diff only.

name: marketpanel-server
reviewNote: server/package.json only has start/dev (node index.js / nodemon). Tests exist (server/__tests__/billing.verify-session.test.js, jobs/__tests__/subscriptionReconciler.test.js) but no test script in that manifest; runner not identified, so null. require('stripe')(...) inline call appears in billing.js, jobs/subscriptionReconciler.js and tests. Large server dir; no lifecycle scripts.

name: irishpubsign-server
invalidReason: Baseline npm ci fails at this pinned commit before migration; the committed package manifest and lockfile need repair. No Stripe migration was run.
reviewNote: Very small Express server; only script is 'start: node index.js'. Two require('stripe')(key) call sites (routes/checkout.js, routes/webhooks.js). No typecheck/test; validate by diff/syntax only. Personal project, low activity.
